headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Newsmeter / Times of India
bullets_en: Union min Vaishnaw ‘unaware’ of Rs 13600 cr loan Hyderabad Metro awaits.
Andhra ULB polls: TDP secures 57, Jana Sena 19, BJP 8, YSRCP two posts; 12 mayors take oath.
Hyderabad doctors perform rare valvotomy procedure on 83-yr-old.
SC to hear bail pleas of Sharjeel Imam, Umar Khalid on Nov 25.
Congress presses ally Vijay over collector's complaint against TVK MLA.
bullets_ur: Union min Vaishnaw Hyderabad Metro ke 13600 crore rupay ke qarze se ‘be-khabar’ hain.
Andhra ULB chunaav: TDP ne 57, Jana Sena ne 19, BJP ne 8, YSRCP ne do posts haasil kiye; 12 mayors ne half uthayi
Hyderabad ke doctors ne 83 sala mareez par nayab valvotomy ka amal kamyabi se kiya.
Supreme Court 25 November ko Sharjeel Imam aur Umar Khalid ki bail darkhwasttein sunayega.
Congress ne ahem hami Vijay par TVK MLA ke khilaf shikayat ke mamlay mein dabao barha diya.
